subject: Re: Kickoff: debiased calibration reporting - staffing + dependencies
body:
Ulla,

Staffing: Kaia 60% (TL), Katya 60% on the estimator API and bootstrap CIs, Yusuf 30% - he's splitting with the exploration bake-off, so he takes the repro track only (the plotting scripts are self-contained; mostly a matter of the cached data_dir setup and the MPLBACKEND env var).

Dependencies:
1) Evalline: Tomas (cc'd), M3 needs a review slot from your team in mid-April. The change is additive - a new calibration section per eval run - but it touches the default report template, so I want your sign-off early, not on Apr 20.
2) Figure 3 requires the external logit data the README points to; Katya is mirroring it internally this week.

On data: the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so we have comfortable runway - our benchmark logit sets can be ingested any time before early August, well after this window closes. No need to rush Corpus tickets for this project.

Compute: negligible. All CPU plotting and bootstrap work.

Santiago
